scenario: WIBTA for going on a trip my wife can no longer go on because of her DUI? | Last year, my wife and I made plans to spend a week in Montreal with another couple we're close friends with. Here's the problem: a month we made all these arrangements, my wife was arrested for drunk driving, and she pleaded guilty to the charge this week.
